summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the completion of a public offering of $90 million aggregate principal amount of 9.600% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes were sold pursuant to an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley, Keefe Bruyette Woods, Piper Sandler, RBC, UBS, and Wells Fargo. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction under an existing shelf registration statement, not a special situation. The filing provides no unusual terms, strategic event, or structural special feature. What to watch: ordinary debt issuance with no equity impact or event-driven angle.
